page.notes: The "/" mark near the bottom centre is a stain, not transcribed. No page number is printed. The decorated initial O of "Obseruandi" is a woodcut and has been joined to the word. The left-margin note is set beside the lines from "miserorum" to "pati."; its position in the margin is approximate. The word "libucrit" is printed as shown; the c may be a misprint for e.
